subject.name: Mathematics
subject.textbook: NCERT Mathematics XII Part I + II (041)
subject.examPattern: CBSE Board exam, 3 h; SQP 2026-27 – 'no change in question paper design'. 50% competency-based, 20% MCQ, 30% SA/LA, ~33% internal choice. Theory 80 + IA 20. 38 questions: A 20×1 (18 MCQ + 2 A-R), B 5×2, C 6×3, D 4×5, E 3 case×4.
